text: This candidate for the Senior Full Stack Software Developer position received an overall fit score of 0.16. The strongest evidence of their technical background is that they have "Built REST APIs" and listed experience with "Node.js", "React", and "Docker". Key gaps include a lack of experience with ruby, sql, git, ci/cd, and cloud computing, as well as insufficient total years of experience. This application was escalated for manual review despite the low fit and missing must-have requirements to allow for a human assessment of their specific technical background.
